headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Telangana Today / Munsif Daily / Deccan Chronicle / The Hindu
bullets_en: Death toll from Hodeidah telecom strikes rises to 17, says Houthi media.
India cites Bengal famine, tells UNSC conflict costs are unequal.
Revanth Reddy Highlights Guru Nanak's Message of Equality, Service.
Andhra Pradesh SEC declares 87 candidates as Deputy Mayors, Vice-Chairpersons.
SEC Sets Dec. 18 Deadline For Election Expenditure Details In 99 ULBs.
bullets_ur: Houthi media ke mutabiq Hodeidah telecom hamlon mein marne walon ki tadaad barh kar 17 ho gayi hai.
India ne Bengal famine ka hawala dete huwe UNSC mein kaha ke jang ki qeematein barabar nahi hoti.
Revanth Reddy ne Guru Nanak ke paigham-e-barabari aur khidmat par roshni dali.
Andhra Pradesh SEC ne 87 ummeedwaron ko Deputy Mayors aur Vice-Chairpersons qarar de diya.
SEC ne 99 ULBs mein intikhabi akhrajaat ki tafseelaat ke liye 18 December ki deadline muqarrar kar di.
